context: Can you explain to me why there is so much fraud in the world? Please include one italic text section in markdown, i.e *italic text*. Make your entire response less than 30 words.

trace.content: Fraud thrives where greed meets weak oversight. *Human nature often prioritizes quick gain over integrity.* Systems fail to catch every deceitful act.
